component.name: PaymentCard
component.business_context: Display of a saved payment method in the merchant dashboard with selection and deletion capabilities

constraints: Card number must be masked except last 4 digits
Show card brand icon (Visa, Mastercard, or Amex)

missing_states: hover — card should have a distinct hover style to signal interactivity
focus-visible — keyboard focus ring must be visible when card is focused
disabled — card may need to be non-selectable (e.g. expired card)
loading — async selection or deletion in progress
deleting — intermediate state while delete API call is in flight
error — failed deletion or failed card load should surface an error
accessibility_gaps: Masked card number must have aria-label='Card ending in 1234' so screen readers announce the meaningful portion, not the bullet characters

Card brand icon (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) must use Icon with aria-hidden=true when the brand name is present as adjacent text; if icon is the sole brand indicator, provide aria-label='Visa' (or relevant brand)
Selectable card must use Card with interactive=true so it renders as <button> with keyboard activation support
Selected state must be announced to assistive technology via aria-pressed (automatically set by Card selected=true when interactive=true)
Expiry date must have a visually-hidden or aria-label context such as 'Expires 12/26' to avoid ambiguous date announcement
Delete IconButton must have aria-label='Delete card ending in 1234' (include last 4 digits) to disambiguate when multiple cards are present
Delete confirmation Modal must trap focus and announce title via aria-labelledby — use Modal with title='Delete card'
During deleting/loading state, the card or Spinner must have an appropriate aria-label (e.g. 'Deleting card ending in 1234') to inform screen reader users of progress
Cardholder name is plain text — ensure color contrast meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) using --color-neutral-900 on --color-neutral-0 backgrounds
responsive_gaps: Delete IconButton touch target must be >= 44x44px on mobile — ensure padding is sufficient at small breakpoints
Card layout must reflow gracefully on narrow viewports (< 375px) — cardholder name and masked number should not overflow or truncate without ellipsis
Brand icon and card details should stack or remain legible at sm breakpoint without horizontal scrolling
Selected state focus ring (--color-focus-ring) must remain fully visible and not be clipped by card overflow:hidden on any viewport
recommendations: Use Card with interactive=true and selected={isSelected} and onClick={handleSelect} for the selectable card container
Use Card with padding='md' as the default padding size for comfortable content density
Use Icon with name='visa', name='mastercard', or name='amex' and aria-hidden=true (when brand label text is present) for the card brand icon
Use IconButton with variant='destructive', size='md', icon=<Icon name='trash' />, and aria-label='Delete card ending in {last4}' for the delete action
Use Modal with title='Delete card' and open={isDeleteModalOpen} and onClose={handleModalClose} for the delete confirmation dialog
Use Button with variant='destructive' and loading={isDeleting} inside the Modal for the confirm-delete action to surface the deleting state
Use Button with variant='secondary' inside the Modal for the cancel action
Use Spinner with size='sm' and label='Deleting card' overlaid on or replacing the Card content during the deleting state
Use Badge with variant='danger' and children='Expired' to flag expired cards, paired with Card disabled styling
Apply --color-focus-ring to the Card focus-visible outline to stay consistent with the design system focus token
Apply --color-neutral-900 for cardholder name and card number text to ensure WCAG AA contrast on --color-neutral-0 card background
Apply --color-muted-foreground for secondary metadata (expiry date label) and --color-foreground for primary text (cardholder name, masked number)

issues_found: Modal must have a title prop
